title: Grateful Dead Live at Home Recordings on 1969-12-31

ai_review.summary: Rough portable‑recorder capture of a rehearsal with a smoking Uncle John’s Band jam, but electric sections are distorted and the overall fidelity is uneven.
ai_review.review: The tape was made on a cheap microphone and portable recorder, so acoustic portions come through clearly while the electric material is noticeably distorted. Despite the lo‑fi sound, reviewers rave about the UJB jam as a highlight, calling the performance epic and full of creative joy. The recording’s historical value (trumpet solo, rehearsal nuances) outweighs its technical shortcomings for many fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (UJB jam, energetic rehearsal) while recording quality is hampered by distortion and low‑grade equipment; the blend yields an overall solid but imperfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captured with a cheap mic/portable recorder – acoustic sections clear, electric parts muddy and distorted; occasional hiss but no major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rehearsal tape with loose structure; band working out arrangements and meter, includes a notable trumpet solo.
